decisions.briefing: Market was flat-to-slightly-negative today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P500 -0.3%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Even though 3 slots are open and cash ($1089.29) is above the buy threshold, none of today's top candidates show the volume-confirmed, multi-signal setup our strategy requires for a new position, so we're holding cash and letting existing positions (up 46.6% overall) continue to run.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow, mixed range today, with the Nasdaq essentially flat and the S&P 500 slipping slightly, reflecting a lack of strong directional conviction from investors. Without a clear catalyst pushing money decisively into or out of risk assets, trading stayed muted and range-bound. No specific market-moving headlines were available for today's session to point to as a driver.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大型指數走勢窄幅震盪，納指幾乎持平，標普500則略為下跌，反映市場缺乏明確方向。由於沒有強力催化劑推動資金大舉進出風險資產，盤面維持區間整理格局。今日並無特定重大新聞可作為市場變動的主因。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to invest when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, even with open portfolio slots and cash available, it's often smarter to hold that cash rather than force a trade — chasing a mediocre setup just to "stay invested" usually hurts returns more than sitting out one more day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「待用資金」（Dry Powder）指的是暫時持有現金、等待真正好機會出現時才投入市場。像今天這種中性行情，即使組合還有空位、現金充裕，持有現金觀望往往比勉強買入一個訊號不夠強的標的更明智——為了「有投入」而勉強交易，通常反而拖累長期表現。
